SylvanasTalentMightOfTheBansheeQueen.name: Might of the Banshee Queen
SylvanasTalentMightOfTheBansheeQueen.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Withering Fire increases Sylvanas's Attack Speed and Spell Power by 5% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

SylvanasUnfurlingShadowsShadowDagger.name: Unfurling Shadows
SylvanasUnfurlingShadowsShadowDagger.description: Quest: Each time an enemy Hero with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse is hit by Shadow Dagger, its damage is permanently increased by 0.5%.

SylvanasTalentOverwhelmingAffliction.name: Overwhelming Affliction
SylvanasTalentOverwhelmingAffliction.description: Enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse are Slowed by 15%. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against Slowed enemy Heroes deal 1% of their maximum Health as damage.

SylvanasTalentUnstablePoison.name: Unstable Poison
SylvanasTalentUnstablePoison.description: Minions that die under the effects of Shadow Dagger or Sylvanas's Traits explode, dealing 130 (+4% per level) damage to nearby Minions, Mercenaries, and Summons.

SylvanasTalentMercenaryQueen.name: Mercenary Queen
SylvanasTalentMercenaryQueen.description: Friendly non-Elite Mercenaries near Sylvanas deal 60% more damage. Sylvanas Stuns and deals 30% additional damage to Mercenaries with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse.

SylvanasHeroicAbilityPossession.name: Possession
SylvanasHeroicAbilityPossession.description: Activate to force an enemy Minion to fight for Sylvanas's team. Catapults require 3 charges. Stores up to 3 charges.

SylvanasTalentWitheringFireBarbedShot.name: Barbed Shot
SylvanasTalentWitheringFireBarbedShot.description: Hitting the same enemy with 5 shots of Withering Fire causes the 5th shot to deal 350% bonus damage.

SylvanasTalentLostSoul.name: Lost Soul
SylvanasTalentLostSoul.description: Increase Shadow Dagger's damage by 10%. Basic Attacks against Heroes with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse reduce the cooldown of Shadow Dagger by 1.75 seconds.

SylvanasTalentFesteringWounds.name: Festering Wounds
SylvanasTalentFesteringWounds.description: Increase Haunting Wave's damage by 15%. Haunting Wave applies 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse.

SylvanasHeroicAbilityWailingArrow.name: Wailing Arrow
SylvanasHeroicAbilityWailingArrow.description: Shoot an arrow that can be reactivated to deal 228 (+4% per level) damage and Silence enemies in an area for 2.5 seconds. The arrow detonates automatically if it reaches maximum range.

SylvanasMindControl.name: Mind Control
SylvanasMindControl.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

SylvanasTalentColdEmbrace.name: Cold Embrace
SylvanasTalentColdEmbrace.description: Shadow Dagger reduces the Armor of the initial target by 25 and any enemy it spreads to by 10 for 2.5 seconds.

SylvanasTalentWindrunnerHauntingWave.name: Windrunner
SylvanasTalentWindrunnerHauntingWave.description: Haunting Wave can be cast a second time for free within 5 seconds after teleporting. Teleporting with Haunting Wave resets the cooldown of Withering Fire.

SylvanasTalentRemorseless.name: Remorseless
SylvanasTalentRemorseless.description: Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Banshee's Curse.

SylvanasTalentWitheringFireEvasiveFire.name: Evasive Fire
SylvanasTalentWitheringFireEvasiveFire.description: Hitting an enemy with Withering Fire grants 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%. Basic Attacks refresh this duration.

SylvanasTalentLifeDrain.name: Life Drain
SylvanasTalentLifeDrain.description: Heal for 15% of damage dealt by Sylvanas to enemies with 3 stacks of Banshee's Curse. Healing is doubled against Heroes.

SylvanasTalentWillOfTheForsaken.name: Will of the Forsaken
SylvanasTalentWillOfTheForsaken.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

SylvanasWailingArrowDeafeningBlast.name: Deafening Blast
SylvanasWailingArrowDeafeningBlast.description: Enemies at the center of Wailing Arrow's explosion take 50% more damage and are Silenced for twice as long.

SylvanasDarkLadysCall.name: Dark Lady's Call
SylvanasDarkLadysCall.description: Heroes hit by Mind Control have their vision radius greatly reduced for 5 seconds. Mind Control's cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

SylvanasTalentWitheringBarrage.name: Withering Barrage
SylvanasTalentWitheringBarrage.description: Withering Fire applies Banshee's Curse, and Heroes hit by Withering Fire reduce its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

GenericTalentFlashoftheStorms.name: Bolt of the Storm
GenericTalentFlashoftheStorms.description: Activate to teleport to a nearby location.
